raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

A PD prefill server serving image requests with optimistic prefill enabled (`--optimistic-prefill-attempts >= 1`, or `--disaggregation-decode-allocation-policy prefill_complete`) can crash with a device-side out-of-bounds assertion in the embedding lookup once a request is yielded and requeued.

`optimistic_release_and_requeue` released the request through `Scheduler._release_aborted_request`. Since #43475 that helper also calls `req.release_mm_inputs_on_abort()` and aborts a streaming session, which is right for a request that is going away but not for one that is about to be prefilled again. The retry then runs with `multimodal_inputs=None` while its input ids still hold the image placeholder values, which are outside the vocabulary by design, and the text-embedding gather asserts. #43442 made this path fire whenever the request slots are exhausted, so an overloaded prefill server hits it regularly; the log line `Req ... exhausted optimistic prefill attempts falling back to bootstrap queue` (or `... optimistic prefill yielded ...`) shows up right before the assert.

## Modifications

- `optimistic_release_and_requeue` now finishes the cache attempt directly (`tree_cache.finish(handle, CacheRequestOutcome.ABORT)`), which is the part of the abort release a requeue still needs. The multimodal inputs and the streaming session stay with the request, as before #43475. Real aborts still go through `_release_aborted_request`.
- `test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_prefill_complete_integration.py`: the existing requeue test's fake request gains the `cache_request_handle` the requeue now reads, and a new `test_requeued_optimistic_request_keeps_multimodal_inputs` pins the regression with the real `Scheduler._release_aborted_request` and `Req.release_mm_inputs_on_abort` bound to fakes. It fails on the unfixed code (`multimodal_inputs` is `None` after the requeue) and passes with this change.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: the change only affects which request state survives a requeue; the retry re-embeds its images as it did before #43475.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). (isort 7.0.0, ruff 0.15.1 check and format, and codespell 2.4.1 pass on the two files.)
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
  - `test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_prefill_complete_integration.py`: 42 passed on this change; the new test fails on main.
  - `test/registered/disaggregation/test_disaggregation_optimistic_prefill.py -k retry_release_retains_donated_checkpoint` (the other test that drives `optimistic_release_and_requeue`, now against a real `UnifiedRadixCache.finish`): passed on one GPU.
  - The rest of `test/registered/unit/disaggregation/`: passed, except `test_kv_checksum.py`, which needs `ninja` and was not run locally.
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (None needed.)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (Not applicable, see above.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+    def test_requeued_optimistic_request_keeps_multimodal_inputs(self):
+        """A yielded optimistic prefill is retried, so it must keep its media.
+
+        The requeue used to go through the scheduler's abort release, which
+        also drops the request's multimodal inputs. The retry then prefilled
+        image placeholder ids with no image features to embed and crashed in
+        the embedding lookup. The requeue must still finish the cache attempt.
+        """
+        override = get_context().override_server_args(optimistic_prefill_attempts=3)
+        override.install()
+        self.addCleanup(override.restore)
+
+        class _Req:
+            release_mm_inputs_on_abort = Req.release_mm_inputs_on_abort
+
+        req = _Req()
+        req.rid = "retry-mm"
+        req.cache_request_handle = CacheRequestHandle(rid="retry-mm", attempt_id=0)
+        req.session = None
+        req.multimodal_inputs = Mock()
+        req.prefill_attempt_count = 0
+        req.output_ids = [42]
+        req.skip_radix_cache_insert = False
+        req.kv = SimpleNamespace(cache_protected_len=16)
+        req.full_untruncated_fill_ids = list(range(32))
+        req._compute_max_prefix_len = Mock(return_value=31)
+        req.storage_prefetch_retry_attempts = 0
+        req.storage_prefetch_last_match_len = None
+        req.reset_for_retract = Mock()
+        req.advance_cache_request_handle = Mock()
+        req.time_stats = MagicMock()
+        scheduler = SimpleNamespace(
+            tree_cache=Mock(supports_mamba=Mock(return_value=False)),
+            clear_pending_chunk_send=Mock(),
+            waiting_queue=[],
+            disagg_prefill_bootstrap_queue=SimpleNamespace(queue=[]),
+            metrics_reporter=SimpleNamespace(enable_metrics=False),
+            processed_tokens_counter=0,
+        )
+        scheduler._release_aborted_request = MethodType(
+            Scheduler._release_aborted_request, scheduler
+        )
+        with (
+            patch("sglang.srt.disaggregation.prefill.checkpoint_kv_cache"),
+            patch("sglang.srt.disaggregation.prefill.release_kv_cache"),
+        ):
+            SchedulerDisaggregationPrefillMixin.optimistic_release_and_requeue(
+                scheduler, req
+            )
+
+        self.assertEqual(scheduler.waiting_queue, [req])
+        self.assertIsNotNone(req.multimodal_inputs)
+        req.multimodal_inputs.release_features.assert_not_called()
+        scheduler.tree_cache.finish.assert_called_once_with(
+            req.cache_request_handle, CacheRequestOutcome.ABORT
+        )
